## **Cryoport Systems Wins Healthcare & Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Excellence Award for Advancing Patient Safety Through ISO 21973-Certified Supply Chain**


Cryoport Systems is proud to announce that it has received the Healthcare & Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Excellence Award at the


[2026 Supply Chain Excellence USA Awards](https://www.supplychainexcellenceawardsusa.com/2026-winners) . Part of a globally recognized awards program with a nearly 30-year legacy, the Supply Chain Excellence Awards recognize organizations that demonstrate innovation, collaboration, and measurable impact through supply chain excellence.


The Healthcare & Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Excellence Award recognizes an organization that demonstrates a measurable impact on patient health outcomes through supply chain excellence. This year’s program attracted a record number of entries, with submissions reviewed by an independent panel of supply chain professionals.


Cryoport Systems was recognized for becoming the


[first global supply chain solutions provider to achieve ISO 21973 certification](https://www.cryoport.com/bio-blog-what-is-iso-21973-and-why-it-matters-for-cell-and-gene-therapy/) , which is the first international standard developed specifically to address the transportation risks associated with human cells for therapeutic use. The certification applies across Cryoport Systems’ global operations, including those serving the U.S. biopharmaceutical and advanced therapy market. It provides a standardized, audited framework designed to strengthen quality and consistency across the complex cell and gene therapy lifecycle.


As an active contributor to the development of ISO 21973, Cryoport Systems helped establish the framework and translate its requirements into operational practice across its infrastructure. The certification helps therapy developers reduce supply chain risk, improve traceability, support regulatory readiness, and enable reliable transportation of critical biological materials from clinical development through commercialization.


The recognition reflects Cryoport Systems’ commitment to advancing quality standards across the life sciences industry and supporting the safe, reliable delivery of life-changing therapies. Ultimately, every advancement in the supply chain is about helping ensure patients receive the treatments they are counting on, when they need them most.
